capabilities: mark a list item complete with (x) or (X)
delete completed list items with a button press
extras: README lists only the supported checkbox syntaxes ((x) and (X)); no screenshots or examples beyond that.
motivation: The author built it for people who enjoy checklists but spend too much time manually deleting completed items, especially on mobile.
problem: Manually deleting finished checklist items is tedious, especially on mobile, so completed tasks clutter the list.
summary: Plugin that deletes a completed list item instantly when you press a button after checking it off.
